incident: An incorrectly scoped source search included ignored environment files and exposed the dedicated sandbox Stripe key and staging encryption key in tool output
encryptionAction: Generated version 2, migrated one connection, verified zero old ciphertext versions, removed the version 1 key from Convex and local runtime files
stripeAction: Rotated in the dedicated sandbox with immediate expiry; old credential returned 401, replacement matched the staging account and was configured securely
followup: Use explicit source directories and exclude ignored environment files before every search. Never print environment values or unsanitized CLI errors. Do not treat the earlier Stripe rotation as containing this later exposure.
